say:1:1123409001:1.source_cn: 朋友们，你们看起来脸色不太好。

say:3:1123409002:1.text: Some Maulers came and harassed Hashir. He left...
say:3:1123409002:1.source_cn: 有些熊人过来骚扰哈什尔，然后他就离开这里了……

say:4:1123409003:1.text: So that's it, then. He's gone.
say:4:1123409003:1.source_cn: 原来如此，他已经离开这片领地了。

choice_prompt:6:1123409003.text: So that's it, then. He's gone.
choice_prompt:6:1123409003.source_cn: 原来如此，他已经离开这片领地了。

say:7:1123409004:1.text: While the reforms of the clan are underway, things aren't as smooth as I'd like them to be.
say:7:1123409004:1.source_cn: 唉，虽然目前部落的改革虽然有所起色，但离我想看到的程度...

say:8:1123409006:1.text: Now Hashir's departure will add more fuel to their fire.
say:8:1123409006:1.source_cn: 现如今，哈什尔的消失会更加助长这些反对声音的气焰。

say:9:1123409007:1.text: In any case, thank you for watching over Hashir all this time.
say:9:1123409007:1.source_cn: 无论如何，都感谢你们这段时间对哈什尔的关照。

say:10:1123409008:1.text: Knowing how he is, there is little we can do but accept his decision in silence. For now...
say:10:1123409008:1.source_cn: 凭我对他的了解，我们只能默默接受这个决定。

say:11:1123409009:1.text: Give me some time to think about Hashir. I'll reach out if I come to any new conclusions.
say:11:1123409009:1.source_cn: 不过希望你们再给我一些时间，我会再争取一个转机，到时候...

say:13:1123409005:1.text: You're right. They are the ones who are opposed to changing tradition.
say:13:1123409005:1.source_cn: 你想得没错，他们应当是反对改变传统的人。
say:13:1123409005:1.male: You're right. They are the ones who are opposed to changing tradition.
say:13:1123409005:1.female: You're right. They are the ones who are opposed to changing tradition.

choice:6:1:2.text: Did the opposition drive Hashir away?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 赶走哈什尔的是反对派吗？
choice:6:1:2.male: Did the opposition drive Hashir away?
choice:6:1:2.female: Did the opposition drive Hashir away?
